list.item: Fixed beliefs that former friends and colleagues are plotting to ruin him, with poor sleep, present for years and worse over the past year; cause not yet established; psychiatric and medical assessment under way: active, confirmed [S]

Weak urinary stream, straining, incomplete emptying (post-void residual 180 mL), and painful urination since childhood, treated for years by self-dilation with urethral sounds; cause not yet established; urethral imaging and endoscopy booked: active, confirmed [S]
Right inguinal hernia, reducible and minimally symptomatic, likely aggravated by years of straining to pass urine: active, confirmed [S]

Engagement without confrontation: listen to his account in full, acknowledge his distress and the real conflicts in his life, neither argue with nor agree with the beliefs, and agree shared goals that matter to him (sleep, less distress, freedom to write, and his bladder); give him copies of his results and notes. Guideline: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Patients With Schizophrenia, Third Edition. Am J Psychiatry 2020;177(9):868-872 (2020); Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR): delusional disorder (2022) [S]

Look for medical, substance, and neurocognitive causes: neurological examination, MoCA, blood count, metabolic panel, calcium, TSH, and vitamin B12; review of medicines and alcohol; brain imaging only if the course or examination is atypical. Guideline: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Patients With Schizophrenia, Third Edition. Am J Psychiatry 2020;177(9):868-872 (2020); Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR): delusional disorder (2022) [S]

Psychiatry consultation to confirm the diagnosis and the differential, assess the risk of harm to himself and others, advise on an antipsychotic and on cognitive behavioral therapy for psychosis, and assess his capacity to consent to urethral surgery. Guideline: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Patients With Schizophrenia, Third Edition. Am J Psychiatry 2020;177(9):868-872 (2020); Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR): delusional disorder (2022) [S]

Structured suicide and violence risk assessment with a written safety plan and the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline; no firearms in the home; risk reviewed at every visit; signs for urgent care written down with him. Guideline: VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for Assessment and Management of Patients at Risk for Suicide (2024) [S]

Urology assessment: IPSS, uroflowmetry, bladder scan for post-void residual, urinalysis, and creatinine now, and kidney and bladder ultrasound this week; retrograde urethrogram, voiding cystourethrogram, and flexible cystoscopy by the urology team next week; stop self-dilation with urethral sounds (urethral rest) and come in the same day if he cannot pass urine. Guideline: Urethral Stricture Disease: AUA Guideline Amendment (2023). Wessells H, et al. J Urol 2023;210(1):64-71. PMID 37096574 (2023) [S]

Right inguinal hernia: watchful waiting while it is minimally symptomatic, with the warning signs of incarceration explained; reassess once the straining has been relieved. Guideline: International guidelines for groin hernia management. HerniaSurge Group. Hernia 2018;22(1):1-165 (2018) [S]

Sleep: fixed rising time, daylight walks, no writing about his enemies after 8 pm, and no sedating antihistamines or anticholinergic sleep aids, which can worsen urinary retention. Guideline: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Patients With Schizophrenia, Third Edition. Am J Psychiatry 2020;177(9):868-872 (2020); Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR): delusional disorder (2022) [S]
